questions.question: Explain the unique features of Goan cuisine. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Goan cuisine blends Konkani traditions with Portuguese influence. Rice, fish, seafood, coconut, kokum,
  • tamarind and chillies are common; dishes include fish curry-rice, vindaloo, xacuti and bebinca.

questions.question: Describe the food culture of the North Eastern States. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• North Eastern food culture is diverse and uses rice, vegetables, herbs, bamboo shoots, fermented foods and
  • locally available meat or fish. Many dishes are steamed, boiled, smoked or fermented; examples include
  • Assamese tenga, Naga smoked pork and momos in Sikkim/Arunachal areas.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the relationship between menu planning and food cost control. / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Menu planning controls food cost by matching dishes to the budget, seasonal prices and available stock.
  • Standard recipes, portion control, ingredient utilisation and planned purchasing reduce waste and help maintain
  • the target food-cost percentage.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Discuss the objectives of menu planning in food service establishments. / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Menu planning aims to provide balanced, appealing and varied meals that meet customer needs and dietary
  • requirements. It also considers budget, seasonality, equipment, staff skills, service style, availability and
  • profitability.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the objectives of food storage. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Food storage preserves quality and safety, slows spoilage, prevents contamination and pest damage, and
  • reduces waste. It also ensures continuous availability, supports stock rotation and helps control purchasing costs.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Describe the advantages and disadvantages of quantity purchasing. / [CO3] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Advantages: bulk discounts, fewer orders and reduced delivery/administrative costs. Disadvantages: higher
  • initial expenditure, greater storage needs, risk of spoilage or obsolescence, tied -up capital and possible wastage.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Classify Indian snacks and discuss their regional variations with suitable examples. / [CO1, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Indian snacks may be classified as fried, steamed, baked/roasted, savoury, sweet and street-food snacks.
  • Regional examples: samosa and kachori (North); dhokla and fafda (Gujarat); vada pav and misal pav
  • (Maharashtra); idli, medu vada and murukku (South); litti-chokha (Bihar); ghugni and pitha (East); momos (North
  • East). Ingredients and methods reflect local crops, climate and traditions.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the principles of menu planning for hospital patients with different dietary requirements. / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Hospital menus should follow the doctor’s/dietitian’s prescription and provide adequate energy, protein,
  • vitamins, minerals and fluids. Consider the patient’s diagnosis, age, nutritional status, allergies, culture, religion,
  • appetite and ability to chew or swallow. Examples include low-sodium diets for hypertension, controlled
  • carbohydrates for diabetes, modified textures for dysphagia, soft diets after surgery and therapeutic diets fo r renal
  • or gastrointestinal conditions. Ensure food safety, attractive presentation, variety, suitable portions and regular
  • monitoring.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the importance of layout planning while installing kitchen equipment for volume feeding. / [CO2, CO3] [10x1 = 10]
questions.solution_html:
• Kitchen layout planning should ensure a smooth one-way workflow from receiving and storage to preparation,
  • cooking, service and washing. Provide adequate space, safe separation of raw and cooked foods, suitable
  • ventilation, drainage, lighting, water and waste disposal. Select equipment according to production volume, menu,
  • power/fuel supply, ergonomics, cleaning and maintenance needs. Allow safe movement, access for cleaning and
  • repairs, fire safety, staff comfort and future expansion. A well-planned layout improves productivity, hygiene,
  • quality control and cost efficiency.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
